name: Cloak of Many Fashions

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Change style

summary: It changes its style, color and quality at your whim.
text: While wearing this cloak, you can take a Bonus Action to change the style, color and apparent quality of the garment. (No other effect in the game.)
